Sandbox_ViewpointCompass_RequireCompassI: Require a Compass item to show the compass
Players must carry the vanilla Compass item to see the compass, regardless of their local setting.
Sandbox_ViewpointCompass_AllowMapWaypoin: Allow map waypoints on the compass
When disabled, map annotations cannot be added to or shown on the compass. Saved selections are kept.
Sandbox_ViewpointCompass_AllowFactionPla: When disabled, the server does not share faction member locations with clients.
Sandbox_ViewpointCompass_MaxFactionPlaye: Caps the range selected by each client. The server never shares faction member locations beyond this distance.
Sandbox_ViewpointCompass_ShowFactionPlay: When disabled, clients receive only the direction of faction members, not their coordinates or exact distance.
